questions.q_en: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.q_hi: भारत के प्रथम प्रधान मंत्री कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first PM of India (1947–1964).

questions.q_en: In which year did the Battle of Plassey take place?
questions.q_hi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष हुआ था?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757.

questions.q_en: What is the chemical formula of Water?
questions.q_hi: पानी का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom (H2O).

questions.q_en: If a triangle has angles 60° and 60°, what is the third angle?
questions.q_hi: यदि एक त्रिभुज के कोण 60° और 60° हैं, तो तीसरा कोण क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Sum of angles in a triangle is 180°. So, 180 - (60+60) = 60°.
